user_saw: The model picker reopened on the selected model's provider tab instead of Favorites when the selected model was not starred, even though Favorites was the last tab chosen.
summary: The model picker now reopens on the Favorites tab whenever it was the last chosen tab, dropping the requirement that Favorites contain the selected model.
reasoning: The removed condition was a deliberate rule added in #199051, documented by the comment 'A remembered Favorites tab opens only while it holds the selected model' and asserted by its test ('An unstarred selection opens its own provider'). The fix reverses that product rule and updates docs accordingly, so it is a behavior change rather than a defect.
